projects.name: Bagdad 2X Expansion
projects.quote: FCX has a potential expansion project to more than double the concentrator capacity of the Bagdad operation in northwest Arizona.

projects.name: Safford/Lone Star oxide expansion
projects.quote: FCX is completing projects at its Safford/Lone Star operation to increase volumes to achieve 300 million pounds of copper per year from oxide ores, which reflects expansion of the initial design capacity of 200 million

projects.name: Grasberg gas-fired combined cycle facility
projects.quote: PT-FI is planning investments in a new gas-fired combined cycle facility.

projects.name: Manyar smelter
projects.quote: Construction progress of the Manyar smelter in Gresik, Indonesia (with a capacity to process approximately 1.7 million metric tons of copper concentrate per year) is advancing on schedule with a target of May 2024 for material construction completion, which will be followed by a ramp-up period through December 2024.

projects.name: Precious Metal Refinery (PMR)
projects.quote: The PMR is being constructed to process gold and silver from the Manyar smelter and PT Smelting.

projects.name: PT Smelting expansion
projects.quote: In December 2023, PT Smelting completed an expansion of its capacity by 30% to 1.3 million metric tons of copper concentrate per year.
